events.desc: Penelope Pitstop: Why, HAYULL-O everybody! Isn't this just the most GORGEOUS manor house y'all have ever seen? Oh my stars, that chandelier is simply DIVINE! Now, before we get started on this little adventure, a proper Southern lady always signs the guest book. Let me just take a teensy little look-see at this darlin' book right here!

Oh, I do declare, this is going to be the most DELIGHTFUL treasure hunt! And with so many friends here to help, why, finding that Doily Diamond will be just like a Sunday picnic! I wonder if that sweet Mr. Sneekly might know something about the diamond — he always seems so well-informed!
Penelope Pitstop examined the guest-book.

The Ant Hill Mob: Alright boys, we made it! Doily Manor in the flesh! Now listen up — Miss Pitstop is RIGHT HERE, and it's our job to make sure nothin' happens to her, see? And I don't like the look of this place one BIT. That chandelier up there looks like it's hangin' by a THREAD! Let me take a good look around before somethin' terrible happens!

I got a funny feelin' about that Sneekly character... every time he's around, somethin' bad happens to Miss Pitstop. Can't quite figure out what it is, but my gut says keep an eye on him. And Dastardly too — those two together spell T-R-U-B-B-L-E!
The Ant Hill Mob examined the null.

Peter Perfect: Why, Miss Pitstop! What an absolutely SPLENDID surprise to find you here at Doily Manor! Peter Perfect, at your service — your GALLANT service, I might add! Now don't you worry about a single thing, because I have formulated a COMPREHENSIVE multi-phase plan for locating this treasure, and Phase One begins RIGHT NOW with a thorough examination of the premises! Starting with this guest book — a TRUE gentleman always signs the guest book, and a BRILLIANT gentleman always READS it first!

Oh, she's even MORE radiant than I remembered! Stay focused, Peter — be heroic, be gallant, be... PERFECT. If I can find clues in this guest book AND impress Penelope simultaneously, well, that's what we in the hero business call a two-for-one special!
Peter Perfect examined the guest-book.
Dick Dastardly: Why, what a DELIGHTFUL little gathering we have here! Don't mind me, I'm simply... admiring the décor. Yes, yes, carry on, nothing to see here!

Heh heh heh! While these bumbling buffoons stand around gawking at each other, the GREAT Dick Dastardly shall uncover the secrets of this manor! That guest book is calling my name — and once I know where the treasure lies, I'll send these fools on a wild goose chase to the kitchen while I claim my GLORIOUS prize!
Dick Dastardly examined the guest-book.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Why, what a SPLENDID old manor this is! Simply SPLENDID! Now then, everyone, do be careful — these old estates can be rather, ah, unpredictable. Penelope dear, you stay close to your guardian Sneekly, won't you? Let me just have a look at this guest book — one should always observe the proper formalities when visiting a historic home!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! That chandelier hangs by a THREAD, practically BEGGING to be dropped on some unsuspecting do-gooder! But patience, Hooded Claw, patience! First I must scout this wretched manor for the PERFECT trap — something so elaborately theatrical that even I shall be impressed! And while these fools fumble about the Entrance Hall, I shall begin unraveling the secrets of Doily Manor. The guest book may reveal who else has visited — and perhaps what became of them! Now THAT would be useful information for a villain of my considerable talents!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) examined the guest-book.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, thank you SO much for keepin' an eye out, boys! Y'all are just the SWEETEST little fellas! Now, I do believe I spotted a simply MARVELOUS library through that doorway — and a lady does love her books! There's supposed to be some kind of inscription on the mantelpiece in there, and I just have a FEELIN' in my bones it might tell us somethin' about that gorgeous Doily Diamond! Wish me luck, sugar plums!

Oh, I just KNOW that library is going to have the most wonderful clues! An inscription on a stone mantelpiece — why, that's practically BEGGIN' to be read! And with all these charming gentlemen around, what could POSSIBLY go wrong?
Penelope Pitstop walked into the library.

The Ant Hill Mob: Watch your step, boys! This place is a DEATHTRAP, I tell ya! Look at that coat rack — wobbly as my cousin Vinnie after a plate of bad clams! If that thing topples over on Miss Pitstop, we'll never — HEY! Miss Pitstop, sweetie, maybe don't stand so close to the — oh, never mind, let ME check it out first!

I got a bad feelin' about this whole setup, see? That Sneekly fella keeps LOOKIN' at that chandelier... or is he lookin' at the coat rack? Or Miss Pitstop? I can't tell, but it ain't GOOD, whatever it is!
The Ant Hill Mob examined the coat-rack.

Dick Dastardly: Well, well, well! Having examined that guest book MOST thoroughly, I can tell you all with ABSOLUTE certainty that the previous owner — the late Lord Doily himself — was a renowned CHEF! Yes, yes, his final entry mentions hiding his most PRIZED possession in the Kitchen, behind the copper pots! You'd ALL better rush there immediately before someone ELSE finds it! Go on, shoo! Every last one of you! Time is of the ESSENCE!

Heh heh heh! Of COURSE there's nothing about a chef in that guest book — I made the whole thing up! While these gullible NITWITS scramble around the Kitchen looking behind pots and pans, the MAGNIFICENT Dick Dastardly will be in the Library, deciphering that mantelpiece inscription and claiming the treasure for HIMSELF! Dastardly, you are a GENIUS!
Dick Dastardly walked into the library.

Peter Perfect: Well now, Miss Pitstop, I have WONDERFUL news! Phase One of my Comprehensive Treasure Location Strategy is complete — the guest book has been thoroughly analyzed! And now, Phase Two commences: the LIBRARY! A carved stone mantelpiece with an inscription, floor-to-ceiling bookshelves — why, that's practically a TREASURE MAP waiting to be read! I shall venture forth and reconnoiter the premises on your behalf. Peter Perfect leaves NO stone unturned and NO inscription unread!

If I can find a clue in that library inscription before anyone else, Penelope will be ENORMOUSLY impressed by my investigative prowess! And did I notice Dick Dastardly reading the guest book right after me? Hmm... no matter — Peter Perfect is ALWAYS two steps ahead!
Peter Perfect walked into the library.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, HELLO there, Rock and Gravel! Aren't y'all just the most ADORABLE little fellas! Now, would you look at this mantelpiece — it has the most DELIGHTFUL riddle carved right into the stone! 'I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish.' Well, bless my heart, I do believe I know this one! It's a MAP, of course! A map has cities and forests and water drawn on it, but none of the REAL things! Let me just see if this ol' mantelpiece has anything to say about that!

Why, I just LOVE a good riddle! And solvin' puzzles in a dusty old library with two cave-men for company — this is exactly the sort of adventure a girl dreams about! I wonder what'll happen when I give the answer...
Penelope Pitstop interacted with the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: BOYS! Miss Pitstop just went into the library ALL BY HERSELF! What are we standin' around here for, examinin' COAT RACKS?! She could be in TERRIBLE danger! Those bookshelves could collapse, the mantelpiece could crumble — it's an OLD BUILDING, see?! Come on, come on, MOVE IT! We gotta get in there before somethin' AWFUL happens! And keep your EYES on that Sneekly fella — there's somethin' about him that gives me the HEEBIE-JEEBIES, though I can't quite put my finger on WHAT!

Every time Miss Pitstop wanders off by herself, my ulcer acts up! And that Sneekly — the way he said 'Penelope DEAR' — nobody talks like that unless they're up to NO GOOD! I just wish I could figure out WHY he makes my skin crawl!
The Ant Hill Mob walked into the library.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): My, my, what a FASCINATING guest book! Now then, I do believe a responsible guardian should scout ahead and ensure these rooms are SAFE for dear Penelope. That Library looks positively ANCIENT — crumbling shelves, heavy stone fixtures — one can never be too careful! I shall go ahead and inspect it first. Everyone DO stay here where it's safe, won't you? Especially you, my dear Penelope — your guardian Sneekly will make SURE everything is in order!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! The LIBRARY! Floor-to-ceiling bookshelves that could TOPPLE like dominoes, a carved stone mantelpiece that could conceal all manner of delicious dangers, and heavy leather chairs perfect for... well, let us just say the possibilities are ENDLESS! While these bumbling do-gooders mill about the Entrance Hall signing guest books like obedient little sheep, the Hooded Claw shall be THREE STEPS AHEAD, scouting the Library for the most MAGNIFICENTLY elaborate trap this side of a Saturday morning! And that inscription on the mantelpiece — it could lead me straight to the treasure! Oh, the BRILLIANCE of my plan is almost too much even for ME to bear! First, find the clues. Second, set the trap. Third — NYAH-HA-HA-HA! Poor, poor Penelope!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) walked into the library.

Peter Perfect: Why, Miss Pitstop! What FORTUITOUS timing — here we are, together in this MAGNIFICENT library! And I couldn't help but notice that SPLENDID inscription on the mantelpiece there. 'Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish' — why, that's elementary, my dear Penelope! The answer is a MAP! A map has all of those things! And if Lord Doily went to the trouble of carving a riddle about a MAP into his mantelpiece, then by GOLLY, there must be a map hidden somewhere in this very room! Stand back, everyone — Peter Perfect is ON the case!

If I can solve this riddle and find a treasure map before anyone else, Penelope will see that Peter Perfect is not just brave and gallant, but BRILLIANT too! Dick Dastardly's little kitchen gambit won't fool ME — the real clues are right here!
Peter Perfect interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Why, Peter Perfect! And Penelope! And the Slag Brothers! What are you ALL doing in here? Didn't you hear? The treasure has ALREADY been found — yes, yes, a fellow in the Entrance Hall just walked off with it! Something about a secret compartment in the staircase! You'd better HURRY if you want to catch him! As for ME, I'm simply here to, ah, enjoy a bit of LIGHT READING. Nothing to see here, no sir!

Heh heh heh! While these GULLIBLE fools rush off to chase a phantom thief, I shall solve this riddle and claim the Doily Diamond! The answer is a MAP, of course — any GENIUS could see that! And I, Dick Dastardly, am the GREATEST genius of them all!
Dick Dastardly interacted with the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Well, GOODNESS gracious, it seems like EVERYBODY decided to join little ol' me in the library! Why, it's practically a PARTY in here! Now then, let me take a REAL close look at this mantelpiece — I gave it my answer about the map, and I just KNOW somethin' wonderful must have happened! A girl's gotta pay attention to the DETAILS, after all!

Why, I do hope my answer was right! A map has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish — that's just GOTTA be it! Let me see if the mantelpiece revealed any secrets. With all these folks crowdin' in here, I'd better figure this out before someone else beats me to the diamond!
Penelope Pitstop examined the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: Alright boys, SPREAD OUT! Form a protective PERIMETER around Miss Pitstop! Clyde, you watch the door! Dum-Dum, you watch the — wait, where's Dum-Dum? Never mind! Now then, Miss Pitstop, you just stay RIGHT HERE where it's safe while I check out this here mantelpiece for — WHOA! *trips over the edge of the rug and stumbles headfirst toward the mantelpiece* OOF! BONK! Hey, wait a minute — this inscription here! Cities but no houses, forests but no trees — why, that's a MAP! It's talkin' about a MAP! There must be a map SOMEWHERE in this library! Quick, boys, check the BOOKSHELVES!

Every time that Sneekly character walks into a room, the hair on the back of my neck stands up like a CAT in a thunderstorm! And now he's in HERE with Miss Pitstop and all these heavy bookshelves that could TOPPLE at any moment! I gotta keep my eyes on him AND keep Miss Pitstop safe — which ain't easy when you got seven guys who can barely tie their own SHOES!
The Ant Hill Mob interacted with the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: Why, what's THIS? The mantelpiece responded to the answer! A MAP — of course! Now then, Miss Pitstop, allow me to conduct a THOROUGH investigation of these bookshelves as well — several volumes appear to be placed upside down, which is HIGHLY suspicious! In my experience, upside-down books are ALWAYS concealing something! Phase Three of my Comprehensive Treasure Location Strategy: the Inverted Volume Inspection!

If there's a hidden map or compartment in this library, Peter Perfect will find it FIRST! Those upside-down books are practically SCREAMING 'secret mechanism' — and solving TWO puzzles in one room will make me look absolutely DASHING in Penelope's eyes!

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh my, oh my — everyone DO be careful! These bookshelves look positively PRECARIOUS! As Penelope's guardian, I simply MUST ensure they won't come crashing down on anyone. Let me just check these volumes here — goodness, several of them appear to be shelved UPSIDE DOWN! How very peculiar! The previous owner must have been quite the eccentric. Let me just... straighten these out for safety's sake...

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! While those bumbling FOOLS crowd around the mantelpiece scratching their heads over that riddle — which ANY fool can see the answer is A MAP — the MAGNIFICENT Hooded Claw shall investigate these suspiciously upside-down books! In every proper manor mystery, upside-down books mean one thing: a HIDDEN MECHANISM! A secret panel, a concealed compartment, perhaps even a passage that leads straight to the treasure! And if I find it first, well... I can also find a way to lure dear, sweet Penelope into whatever DELIGHTFULLY dangerous surprises await beyond it! Oh, the GENIUS of it all — hiding my villainy behind the mask of a fussy, overprotective guardian! Those Ant Hill hooligans may have their suspicions, but suspicion without PROOF is just paranoia! Nyah-ha-ha-HA!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) examined the bookshelves.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, Dick Dastardly, that is just the SWEETEST thing, tryin' to warn us about some mysterious treasure thief! But I think I'll just stay RIGHT here, thank you very much! Now then, this riddle is just DARLIN' — 'cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish' — why, that's a MAP, of course! Every Southern belle knows her geography! Let me just give this mantelpiece a little... nudge...

Why, that Dick Dastardly is SUCH a helpful gentleman, always lookin' out for us! Though I do wonder why he's so eager for everyone to leave this room... Oh well, I'm sure it's nothin'! Now let's see what happens when I solve this riddle!
Penelope Pitstop interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Oh, what a SHAME! I've just examined the mantelpiece most thoroughly, and I can tell you all it's a DEAD END! Nothing but decorative nonsense! The riddle is clearly just an old Victorian parlour game — no treasure connection WHATSOEVER! I suggest you all try the Laboratory next — I heard strange noises coming from there! Very promising, very promising indeed!

Heh heh heh! A MAP, of course! And those upside-down books on the shelves — CLEARLY a clue that the magnificent Dick Dastardly alone has noticed! While these simpletons waste time gawking at the mantelpiece, I shall investigate those suspicious bookshelves and find the map to the Doily Diamond! Dastardly, you SCOUNDREL, you've done it again!

Peter Perfect: Why, SNEEKLY, old boy, how very KIND of you to check those bookshelves for safety! Though I must say, I was JUST about to do that myself — Peter Perfect is NOTHING if not thorough! But no matter — the REAL prize is right HERE on this mantelpiece! The Ant Hill Mob stumbled upon the answer — quite literally, ha ha — but it takes a man of REFINED intellect to properly examine what was REVEALED! Now then, Miss Pitstop, allow me to give this mantelpiece a PROPER Peter Perfect inspection! If there's a map hidden here, I shall find it for YOU!

Hmm, Sneekly is awfully interested in those bookshelves... almost as if he's looking for something specific. But no — he's Penelope's guardian! He must simply be concerned for everyone's safety. Still, I'd better get to that mantelpiece before anyone else pieces together the FULL clue! A gallant gentleman must stay one step ahead!
Peter Perfect interacted with the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: A MAP, boys! The answer is a MAP! And WHERE do you hide a map? In a LIBRARY, that's where! And LOOK at those bookshelves — some of them books are UPSIDE DOWN! That's a CLUE if I ever saw one! Now everybody just STAY PUT while I — *shuffles sideways trying to keep one eye on Sneekly and one on the bookshelves* — while I investigate these here volumes! And YOU, Mr. Sneekly — don't you move a MUSCLE! I got my EYE on you! Well, HALF an eye! The other half is on the books! Clyde, you watch him with YOUR eyes! Between the two of us we got almost ENOUGH eyes to — WHOOPS!

Every time I look at that Sneekly fella, somethin' in my GUT tells me he's BAD NEWS! The way he hovers around Miss Pitstop like a VULTURE over a picnic basket! If only I could figure out WHAT it is about him! But I ain't exactly the brains of this operation — I'm more the CRASH-INTO-THINGS department!
The Ant Hill Mob examined the bookshelves.

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Now then, let me just turn these upside-down volumes RIGHT-side up — we can't have books falling on dear Penelope's head, can we? Oh my, this one seems rather STUCK... let me just give it a good firm — *tug* —

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! While Peter Perfect wastes time ANNOUNCING his 'Inverted Volume Inspection Strategy' — honestly, does the man need a PHASE NUMBER for everything? — the Hooded Claw simply ACTS! These upside-down books are OBVIOUSLY a triggering mechanism — pull the right one and something MAGNIFICENT happens! A secret passage, a hidden vault, perhaps a delightfully treacherous trapdoor! And if it IS a trapdoor, well... all I need to do is position dear Penelope RIGHT on top of it and give the book another pull! Oh, the ELEGANCE! The ARTISTRY! The sheer THEATRICAL BRILLIANCE of it all! Nyah-ha-ha-HA!

Penelope Pitstop: Why, Dick Dastardly, you are SUCH a thoughtful gentleman, suggestin' we try the Laboratory! But a lady never leaves a room without finishin' her business first, and these upside-down books have got my curiosity just TICKLED pink! Now, the Ant Hill Mob AND Peter Perfect AND dear Mr. Sneekly ALL noticed them — why, when THREE groups of gentlemen agree on somethin', a girl would be PLUMB FOOLISH not to take a peek! Let me just see what's hidin' behind these topsy-turvy volumes...

Why, that Dick Dastardly is just SO concerned about our safety — always tryin' to steer us away from danger! Though I must say, it IS a teensy bit peculiar how he examined that mantelpiece and declared it a dead end RIGHT after I interacted with it... Oh well! Now then — upside-down books in a library with a riddle about a MAP? Why, even a debutante from Mobile knows THAT'S worth investigatin'!

Dick Dastardly: Oh NEVER MIND the bookshelves, you bumbling buffoons! Can't you see they're just ORDINARY dusty old books? Nothing of VALUE there whatsoever! Now, if you'll EXCUSE me, I have important business elsewhere — yes, the Laboratory! I just remembered I left my, er, SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT in there! Very urgent! You should ALL stay here and keep reading!

Heh heh heh! REVERSE psychology, Dastardly, you DEVIL! Tell them the bookshelves are worthless and they'll NEVER leave them! Meanwhile, I shall examine this mantelpiece up close — Penelope interacted with it and something HAPPENED! If there's a secret compartment or a hidden map, the MAGNIFICENT Dick Dastardly shall find it! Those upside-down books are suspicious too — but first, the mantelpiece! Always go where the treasure RESPONDS!
Dick Dastardly examined the bookshelves.

Peter Perfect: AH HA! Just as I SUSPECTED! Dick Dastardly, old boy, you said this was a DEAD END, but Peter Perfect's trained eye says OTHERWISE! The answer to this riddle is plainly a MAP — Miss Pitstop deduced it BRILLIANTLY, I might add — and now let me see what this magnificent mantelpiece has REVEALED! A gentleman ALWAYS follows through on his investigation, and Peter Perfect is NOTHING if not thorough! Stand back, everyone — let me take a CLOSER look at what we've uncovered here!

Dick Dastardly trying to shoo everyone away from the mantelpiece is MORE suspicious than a flat tire on race day! If he says it's worthless, it's DEFINITELY worth something! And I simply MUST be the one to present whatever's hidden here to dear Penelope — THAT will surely win her admiration!
Peter Perfect examined the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: Alright, ALRIGHT, nobody panic! I already LOOKED at these books and I can see PLAIN AS DAY that some of 'em are upside down! Now, I ain't no literary CRITIC, but even I know that books go RIGHT SIDE UP! So I'm gonna just reach over here and — Clyde, hold my hat — and turn these suspicious volumes around because CLEARLY somebody put 'em that way for a REASON! And Mr. Sneekly, I NOTICED you was already pokin' around these same shelves, which is VERY interestin' considerin' I don't trust you as far as I can THROW you — which admittedly ain't very far on account of my SHORT ARMS! Now then, let's see what happens when I — *reaches for the upside-down books* — WHOOOAA, this carpet is SLIPPERY!

Every time that Sneekly fella gets near Miss Pitstop's clues, my stomach does FLIP-FLOPS! He examined these SAME bookshelves before me — what if he already TOOK somethin'?! I can't PROVE nothin' but my gut's never wrong — well, it's SOMETIMES wrong about lunch, but NEVER about villains!

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh DEAR, oh dear! Peter, do be careful with that mantelpiece — those old stone fixtures can be TERRIBLY unstable! As Penelope's legal guardian, I simply MUST inspect it myself to ensure it's safe. A MAP, you say, my dear? How CLEVER of you! Let your old Uncle Sneekly just have a little look-see at what Peter's found — purely for SAFETY purposes, of course!

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! The bookshelves were a BUST — no hidden levers, no trapdoors, NOTHING! But the mantelpiece — oh, the MANTELPIECE! That fool Peter Perfect has already pawed at it, and Penelope has solved the riddle — a MAP! If there's a map concealed within that stone fixture, it will lead straight to the Doily Diamond, and the Hooded Claw shall HAVE it! And once I know where the treasure lies, I can prepare a SPECTACULAR demise for dear Penelope along the route! Perhaps a collapsing corridor, or a pit of — oh, the possibilities make my villainous heart SING! But first — first I must see what that mantelpiece is hiding! Nyah-ha-ha-HA!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Yes, yes, you all keep fumbling with those WORTHLESS old books! Very entertaining! Meanwhile, I shall just, er, lean casually against this mantelpiece here — purely for SUPPORT, you understand! My back is simply KILLING me from all this detective work!

Heh heh HEH! Every single one of these dimwits is fighting over the bookshelves while the REAL prize is right here on this mantelpiece! Peter Perfect interacted with it and something HAPPENED — if there's a hidden compartment or a map, Dick Dastardly shall SNATCH it right from under their noses! The answer to the riddle is a MAP, and I intend to be the one HOLDING it!
Dick Dastardly interacted with the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Why, Dick Dastardly, you are JUST the most considerate gentleman, wantin' us all to be safe! But sugar, a lady's curiosity is like a magnolia in bloom — you simply CANNOT stop it once it gets goin'! Now, those upside-down books are just FASCINATIN' — let me take a REAL good look at them! After all, the riddle said the answer is a MAP, and where better to hide a map than amongst a whole mess of books? Let me just peer in here real close-like...

Now isn't it just the SWEETEST thing how Dick Dastardly examined those bookshelves and then immediately tried to hustle everyone out of the room? Why, he must be tryin' to protect us from paper cuts! Such a gentleman!
Penelope Pitstop examined the bookshelves.

Peter Perfect: Why, Miss Pitstop, OBSERVE! The answer to this riddle is as clear as a sunny day at the racetrack — a MAP! Cities but no houses, forests but no trees, water but no fish — it can ONLY be a map! And as you so BRILLIANTLY deduced yourself, where better to hide a map than in a LIBRARY! Now then, let Peter Perfect do the honors — I shall solve this mantelpiece riddle and reveal its secrets! Stand back, everyone — particularly YOU, Dastardly, since you were SO eager for us all to LEAVE! A gentleman investigator ALWAYS follows the clues that the villain wants him to IGNORE!

If this mantelpiece has a hidden mechanism, solving the riddle should trigger it! And the look on Penelope's face when I crack it open — why, she'll see that Peter Perfect is BOTH brains AND brawn! Dastardly practically CONFIRMED this is the right track by trying so hard to get everyone to leave!
Peter Perfect interacted with the mantelpiece.

The Ant Hill Mob: WHOOOAAA! This carpet — I TOLD you it was slippery! My FEET are goin' every which way and I can't — LOOK OUT, MR. SNEEKLY! — I'm comin' in HOT! *slides across the library floor on the dusty carpet* GANGWAY, GANGWAY! Clyde, grab my BELT! Too late — *CRASH* — oof! Well, would you LOOK at that, I ended up right at the mantelpiece! Since I'm HERE, let me just take a GANDER at this inscription myself! 'Cities but no houses' — why, even a CROOK knows that's a MAP! Now let's see what this thing DOES when you — *fumbles with the stonework*

Every time that Sneekly gets his mitts on a clue before Miss Pitstop, my BLOOD PRESSURE goes through the ROOF! I don't know WHAT his game is, but if I accidentally knock him away from that mantelpiece while I'm slidin' across this floor — well, that's just PHYSICS, ain't it?!
The Ant Hill Mob interacted with the mantelpiece.

Dick Dastardly: Oh, nothing to see here, nothing at ALL! Just a boring old fireplace! Why don't you ALL go examine those FASCINATING upside-down books with Miss Pitstop? I hear they contain a COMPLETE guide to treasure hunting — VERY informative! I'll just stay here and, er, rest my weary bones against this perfectly ORDINARY mantelpiece!

Heh heh HEH! Keep them looking at those worthless books while the MAGNIFICENT Dick Dastardly discovers what this mantelpiece has revealed! Something DEFINITELY shifted when I pressed on it — I felt it MOVE! One more careful look and the treasure will be MINE! ALL MINE!
Dick Dastardly examined the mantelpiece.

Penelope Pitstop: Well, would you LOOK at that! These books are upside down, and I do declare, that is NOT how a proper Southern lady keeps her library! Now, the riddle on that mantelpiece said the answer is a MAP, and I have a SNEAKIN' suspicion that these topsy-turvy volumes are tryin' to tell us somethin'! Let me just turn these darlin' little books the RIGHT way 'round and see what happens! A lady always tidies up — it's just good MANNERS!

Why, those upside-down books are practically SCREAMIN' 'secret mechanism!' Even I can see that, and I'm usually too busy fixin' my hair to notice such things! I do hope turnin' them reveals a map or a secret passage — wouldn't that just be the most THRILLING thing?

The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly): Oh my, oh MY! Dick Dastardly, please don't LEAN on that ancient stonework — it could crumble at any moment! As Penelope's guardian, I simply CANNOT allow anyone to damage potential safety hazards before I've had them properly assessed! Now then, let me just have a VERY careful look at this mantelpiece. The answer to the riddle is clearly a MAP, as my brilliant ward so cleverly deduced — and where there's a riddle, there's usually a MECHANISM! Perhaps if one presses the right stone, or traces the inscription just SO...

Nyah-ha-ha-HA! That wretched Dick Dastardly thinks he can beat the Hooded Claw to the prize by LEANING on the mantelpiece like some common street loafer! The NERVE! But I, the magnificently devious Hooded Claw, shall examine every crack, every crevice of this stone fixture with the precision of a master criminal! If there is a map hidden within — and there MUST be — I shall find it FIRST! And once I know the path to the Doily Diamond, I can arrange a most SPECTACULAR series of obstacles along Penelope's route! Perhaps a carefully balanced bookshelf that TOPPLES at the lightest touch, or a trapdoor beneath those dusty reading chairs! Oh, the ANTICIPATION is simply DELICIOUS!
The Hooded Claw (as Sneekly) examined the mantelpiece.

Peter Perfect: AHA! The riddle has been ANSWERED, ladies and gentlemen! A MAP — cities without houses, forests without trees, water without fish! Now let me just examine this mantelpiece MORE closely to see what my BRILLIANT deduction has revealed! Why, I do believe something has SHIFTED in the stonework!
